parts.html: Express Interior Design Package — €20/m²

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the Express Interior Design Package for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces where a professional interior concept needs to be developed quickly without an extended set of technical documentation.
The package includes a measured floor plan, functional furniture layout, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of the main rooms.
You can see the future interior in advance and evaluate the layout, combination of materials, furniture, lighting, and color solutions before finishing works begin.

The Express Package is an optimal solution for properties where the main construction and engineering decisions have already been defined but a professional interior concept and clear visual direction are still required for further implementation.
What Is Included in the Express Package
1. Measured Floor Plan
Before the design process begins, the main dimensions of the space, walls, window and door openings, utilities, and other architectural elements are recorded.
The measured floor plan becomes the accurate basis for developing the layout and subsequent 3D visualizations.
2. Furniture Layout Plan
A functional layout is developed with the placement of furniture and the main interior elements.
The design takes into account room dimensions, circulation, ergonomics, storage systems, and everyday scenarios for using the space.
A well-planned furniture layout makes it possible to understand before finishing works begin how efficiently the available space is used and how comfortable the interior will be.
3. Photorealistic 3D Visualization
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are developed for each main room.
The visualizations show furniture, finishing materials, lighting, color combinations, textiles, decorative elements, and the overall atmosphere of the space.
You can see the future interior before implementation begins and evaluate in advance whether the proposed concept meets your expectations.
The package includes one round of revisions to the developed concept.
Fast Interior Design Without Unnecessary Documentation
The main advantage of the Express Package is the ability to receive a professionally developed interior concept within a short timeframe.
Unlike extended design packages, Express does not include a complete set of construction and engineering drawings.
This allows the project to focus on the key tasks: layout, functionality, style, and the visual character of the future space.

The package is particularly suitable for properties where engineering solutions have already been developed, renovation is being carried out according to existing documentation, or the client primarily needs a professional visual interior concept.
What Types of Properties Is the Express Package Suitable For?
The package can be used for apartments in new developments, resale properties, private houses, investment properties, offices, small shops, beauty salons, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.
Each concept is developed individually, taking into account the architecture of the property, its size, function, the client’s preferences, and the required level of functionality.
Who Is the Express Package For?

The package is suitable if you need to quickly develop an interior concept before finishing works begin, determine the optimal furniture arrangement, define the overall style of the space, select combinations of materials and colors, and see the future interior through photorealistic 3D visualizations.
It is also suitable if you do not require a complete set of technical documentation or if the main construction decisions have already been defined in another project.
The Express Package is a practical option both for private residential properties and investment projects where speed, visual appeal, and efficient use of space are especially important.
What You Receive
As a result, you receive a professionally developed interior concept including a measured floor plan, functional furniture layout, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of the main rooms.

You can understand in advance how the property will look after completion, which materials and color combinations should be used, how the furniture should be positioned, and what the overall visual character of the space will be.
The project becomes a clear visual basis for the further implementation of the interior.
Express Interior Design Package Price
€20/m²
Minimum package price — €1,500.
The final price depends on the size of the property, number of rooms, and project complexity.
Completion time — from 14 days after layout approval.
What Is Not Included in the Express Package
The Express Package focuses on space planning and the visual interior concept and does not include a complete set of working drawings for the construction team.

If the property requires demolition and construction plans, electrical layouts, lighting plans, plumbing layouts, ceiling plans, flooring plans, wall elevations, and other technical documentation, we recommend choosing the Basic Interior Design Package.
This distinction allows you to choose exactly the level of design documentation required for your specific property.
Additional Services

If required, the Express Package can be supplemented with individual technical drawings, electrical, lighting and plumbing planning, custom furniture design, furniture drawings, preparation of a detailed renovation cost estimate, design supervision, project procurement, custom furniture production and installation, as well as turnkey renovation.
This allows you to begin with a fast interior concept and expand the project with additional services at later stages if necessary.
Interior Design in Bratislava and Vienna

DUMSKAYA DESIGN works with residential and commercial interiors, combining functional space planning, modern visualization, technical design, custom-made furniture, and complete project implementation.
The studio’s main geographic focus is Bratislava and Vienna. We also work on projects in other cities across Europe and the USA.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — interior design, custom furniture, and complete interior implementation.
Order the Express Interior Design Package

If you need to quickly define the layout, style, and visual character of your future interior, the Express Package allows you to receive a professionally developed concept without an extended set of technical documentation.
